conclusion: The preserved old mapping substantially reduced decode throughput while comparable Level-2 traces attribute most of the loss to longer aggregate q4rdna GEMV dispatch duration. The same binary exposes an isolated split-K wave32 alternative by unsetting LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_MAPPING, so a runtime-only candidate experiment is justified without further profiling.
missing_evidence: split-K candidate performance has not been measured
split-K candidate quality has not been measured
targeted counters and telemetry are not integrated, so the underlying hardware behavior remains unknown

hypothesis.interpretation: Selecting the old Q4_RDNA mapping is causally associated with the measured throughput regression: tg128/tg512 fell from 96.2/96.0 tok/s to 60.8/61.1 tok/s, and comparable timing traces show that increased aggregate q4rdna quantized GEMV duration accounts for most of that loss. Hardware-level causes cannot be classified from timing-only evidence, but choosing the alternative mapping directly tests whether mapping selection controls the regression.
hypothesis.proposed_change: Keep LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_SIDECAR=/models/qwen3-8b.q4rdna and the identical prepared binary, but unset LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_MAPPING so the runtime selects the split-K wave32 mapping. Make no source or build changes.
hypothesis.expected_performance_signature: Relative to the preserved old-mapping experiment, aggregate duration of the dominant q4rdna quantized GEMV dispatches should decrease, with corresponding increases at both tg128 and tg512. Recovery toward the hash-bound baseline is plausible but not assumed.
hypothesis.expected_e2e_effect: Materially improve decode throughput over the approximately 61 tok/s old-mapping result at both benchmark coordinates while preserving stability and exact binary/protocol comparability; whether it matches or exceeds the approximately 96 tok/s baseline must be measured.
risks: The split-K wave32 mapping may not reduce end-to-end time despite improving the dominant dispatches.
The candidate may fail stability or deterministic performance eligibility at one benchmark coordinate.
The sidecar or mapping may alter correctness or quality, requiring validation after performance eligibility.
An inherited LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_MAPPING value could invalidate isolation unless explicitly unset.
required_validation: Run the canonical fresh unprofiled llama-bench coordinates tg128 and tg512 with three samples per coordinate and the required stability checks.
Record LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_SIDECAR=/models/qwen3-8b.q4rdna and explicitly unset LLAMA_Q4_RDNA_MAPPING for every candidate run.
Apply the deterministic performance pre-gate before any expensive quality evaluation.
If performance-eligible, run the required correctness and quality evaluation and preserve its raw and normalized outputs.
If performance fails, preserve the negative experiment; obtain a comparable Level-2 timing trace only if needed to explain its measured signature.
hypothesis.stop_condition: Stop this hypothesis if the candidate fails comparability or stability, fails the deterministic performance pre-gate at either required coordinate, or, after performance eligibility, fails required correctness or quality validation; do not vary additional runtime or source variables within the same experiment.
